title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Desk Bulletin — Daily Held-Funds Rate on Undeducted Registry Credit (Merchandise Purchases)
content:
**Rate rule.** Where registry credit spent on a Merchandise Purchases unit was left undeducted at payment, the daily held-funds rate depends on the status, in the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry records, of the registry holding the spent credit, and on whether the registrant holds an active card in the Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards program:

| Registry holding the spent credit | Active Marlowe & Finch card held | Daily held-funds rate |
|---|---|---|
| in its completion period | Yes | completion rate, $0.60 per day |
| still active, before its completion period | Yes | pre-event rate, $0.30 per day |

Both parts of a row must hold. A registrant who meets neither row is outside this bulletin.

## Combinations

| Registry status | Active card | Result |
|---|---|---|
| completion period | Yes | $0.60 |
| completion period | No | outside this bulletin |
| active, before completion | Yes | $0.30 |
| active, before completion | No | outside this bulletin |
| any other status | Yes or No | outside this bulletin |

## Hypothetical figures

The rate times 14 held-funds days is $8.40 at the completion rate and $4.20 at the pre-event rate.
